spec.description: Season-boundary audit on v7.5 (final: per-depth mask c0c9918, cavern keep-alive c706467, created entries on their cast key; X3v75b froze on the brook fort) (full pool, seven layers, created entries, per-depth cavern casts): lake, ocean and brook forts, spring -> summer -> autumn (two changes, 2,000 ticks past the second), 1 replicate, DF restarted for every cell. The forts' saved v7.4 casts are rebuilt on the seven layers at load, which creates the population entries for cast species DF never stocked. Measured as X3, plus: cavern arrivals against their own depth's cast, and arrivals drawn from the tool's created entries. Passes with 0 off-cast arrivals later than one day after a change, 0 in-cast trims, every dismissed group off the map within 10 days, and 0 cavern arrivals at a depth their species is not cast at later than one day after a change.
